answer_1.quote: Table QA uses structured table as world knowledge to answer questions.

answer_2.quote: We used Exact Match Accuracy as the evaluation metric, which checks whether the predicted answers are equal to the ground truth.

answer_4.quote: To evaluate the quality of adversarial example generation, we conducted human evaluations to compare the quality of the examples generated by the LETA framework with those created by human annotators. Two evaluators were then asked to rate each sample on a scale of 1 (worst) to 5 (best) and determine which example was better, between the one created by human annotators and the framework.
answer_4.guideline: Rate on a scale of 1 to 5 and determine which example is better.
